cases.counterfactual_program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((h (rows g))
         (w (cols g))
         (top-color (at g 0 1))
         (bot-color (at g (- h 1) 1))
         (left-color (at g 1 0))
         (right-color (at g 1 (- w 1)))
         (top-count (for*/sum ((r (range 1 (- h 1))) (c (range 1 (- w 1))))
                      (if (= (at g r c) top-color) 1 0)))
         (bot-count (for*/sum ((r (range 1 (- h 1))) (c (range 1 (- w 1))))
                      (if (= (at g r c) bot-color) 1 0)))
         (left-count (for*/sum ((r (range 1 (- h 1))) (c (range 1 (- w 1))))
                       (if (= (at g r c) left-color) 1 0)))
         (right-count (for*/sum ((r (range 1 (- h 1))) (c (range 1 (- w 1))))
                        (if (= (at g r c) right-color) 1 0)))
         (dominant-color top-color)
         (result (make-hash)))
    (for* ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
      (hash-set! result (list r c)
        (if (or (zero? r) (= r (- h 1)) (zero? c) (= c (- w 1)))
            (at g r c)
            0)))
    (for* ((r (range 1 (- h 1))) (c (range 1 (- w 1))))
      (let ((v (at g r c)))
        (when (!= v 0)
          (cond
            ((= v top-color)
             (if (= v dominant-color)
                 (for ((rr (range 1 (+ r 1)))) (hash-set! result (list rr c) v))
                 (hash-set! result (list 1 c) v)))
            ((= v bot-color)
             (if (= v dominant-color)
                 (for ((rr (range r (- h 1)))) (hash-set! result (list rr c) v))
                 (hash-set! result (list (- h 2) c) v)))
            ((= v left-color)
             (if (= v dominant-color)
                 (for ((cc (range 1 (+ c 1)))) (hash-set! result (list r cc) v))
                 (hash-set! result (list r 1) v)))
            ((= v right-color)
             (if (= v dominant-color)
                 (for ((cc (range c (- w 1)))) (hash-set! result (list r cc) v))
                 (hash-set! result (list r (- w 2)) v)))))))
    (cellmap g (r c v) (hash-ref result (list r c) 0)))))

intermediate: The selected dominant route together with the four route counts that justify that selection.
step_a: Count interior pixels that match each of the four border-route colors, then choose the unique route with the greatest count.
step_b: Move every matching pixel toward its color-defined wall, but expand complete source-to-wall traces only for pixels on the selected dominant route; erase non-route distractors.
why_b_depends_on_a: Which paths become full traces is input-dependent. Step B cannot know which route to expand until Step A compares the route counts; substituting a different selected route changes the output while leaving the rest of the transformation unchanged.
